lesson: Counts without tree+method+timestamp are void (555 arbiter rule, adopted 2026-09-15): '328' vs '212' vs '374' skills were all real numbers from different trees (AAA vs .hermes) and different methods (symlink-follow vs real-path find). The 19,122-token ad-tax and 78-duplicate-names claims were unreproducible — measured truth: 14,083-15.4K tokens, 0 duplicate names (1 unnamed file; the '7 empty descriptions' were YAML block-scalar regex false-positives). The '1,142 dirty files' was the .hermes tree (1,143) misattributed; AAA was 126.
